scope: Synthetic parser, deterministic elapsed-time accounting, tariff boundary allocation and conservative usage-quality gates. No customer bill, new model request, tariff activation or utility account action.
expectations: Identical repeats retain one value with a warning; conflicts and overlaps fail closed
Explicit DST offsets preserve distinct instants; ambiguous or nonexistent naive times require correction
Durations and coverage use elapsed UTC time; daily baseline fractions respect local calendar-day length
Energy is conserved when splitting at actual tariff clock boundaries
Units, timestamps, durations and finite nonboolean quantities must be validated
Multiple ESPI reading types require an explicit supported mapping, never a first-global-unit guess
Insufficient usage may show illustrative calculations but not a definite annual saving or switching recommendation
limits: Interval energy split across a rate boundary assumes uniform power within the supplied interval
This protocol does not prove noisy OCR accuracy, complete bill reconstruction, current tariff-cell correctness or household savings
Further bill-field, monetary rounding, source-update lifecycle and cancellation checks remain separate
